query:
SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name, ss.session_id, ss.absent, ss.role,
       ses.problem_number, ses.session_number, ses.status
FROM students s
JOIN session_students ss ON ss.student_id = s.id
JOIN sessions ses ON ses.id = ss.session_id
WHERE s.name LIKE '%Luana%'
ORDER BY ses.problem_number, ses.session_number;
